criteria.description: The audited collection route pages contain no setInterval or setTimeout data refresh logic.
criteria.verification: Search audited route pages for setInterval and setTimeout.

criteria.description: The audited collection route pages do not expose manual refresh buttons or click handlers that reload all collection data.
criteria.verification: Search audited route pages for refresh UI and load-on-click patterns.

criteria.description: Mutation handlers do not re-bootstrap services or deployment history collections; they rely on store updates from command results and live subscription events.
criteria.verification: Inspect services create handler and deployments rollback handler for post-mutation loadServices/loadAll/bootstrap calls.

criteria.description: Filters and pagination are computed reactively with $derived so store changes are reflected without manual reloads.
criteria.verification: Inspect audited route pages for $derived filtered and paginated views.
